title: Senior Product Manager, Customer Experience
jd_excerpt:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Customer Experience (CX) team and help shape how home service businesses get support, hear from us, and succeed with Jobber .
 Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, electricians, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber, they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn't like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That's why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!
 Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail's Canada's Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada's Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. We've come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we've just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers .
 The team 
 Customer Experience (CX) 's mission is to set service providers up to succeed with Jobber every day.
 We own our in-product support experience, sign-up and onboarding, and cart and checkout, along with the customer profiles, industry success playbooks, and AI-powered tools that help each provider reach the next growth milestone that matters to their business. CX also owns customer trust at Jobber: how we earn it, and how we measure it.
 CX is a horizontal team, which means our work touches every part of Jobber. We partner with product, design and engineering teams throughout the company, and with leaders across Customer Success, Support, Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations, to set goals and track progress.
 The role 
 Reporting to the VP, Customer Experience Innovation, you will lead product strategy and execution for key areas of the CX roadmap. You'll work alongside our CX leadership team across Product, Engineering, and Design to set direction, define what success looks like, and deliver results.
 This is an opportunity to take on some of Jobber's most important customer problems, with a clear mandate to rethink how we support, coach, and communicate with our customers using AI. Your work will span our customer channels and the AI agents behind them, proactive coaching built on customer profiles and industry success playbooks, and omni-channel communications in and out of the product. The areas you own may shift as our priorities do.
 As a Senior Product Manager, Customer Experience, you will: 
 Lead end-to-end product development for key CX initiatives, from discovery and strategy through to delivery.
 Get close to our customers , talking with service providers and our Marketing, Support, and Success teams to understand their pain points first-hand.
 Use data and customer insights to drive decisions , identifying the biggest opportunities, sizing their impact, and measuring results.
 Think in systems , connecting support, communications, and the in-product experience so they work as one for our customers.
 Work horizontally across Jobber , partnering with other product teams and with Customer Success, Support, Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations to prioritize key strategies and initiatives.
 Shape how AI supports our customers and teams , including when to automate, when to bring in a person, and how we measure quality and trust.
 Define and execute the roadmap , balancing short-term wins with long-term innovation.
 Own the outcomes for your area , with accountability for how easily customers get help, how quickly their issues are resolved, and how successful they are with Jobber, and report on progress to senior leadership.
 To be successful, you should have: 
 Proven experience as a Senior Product Manager in a SaaS or technology company, with a track record of driving measurable outcomes.
 Experience owning customer-facing products in areas like onboarding, adoption, retention, or customer support. We care more about how you've improved customers' lives than which industry you've worked in.
 A deep curiosity about customers. You talk to customers regularly, dig into their pain points, and bring what you learn back to your team.
 Strong systems thinking , with the ability to connect customer needs, product experiences, and business outcomes, and to explain complex systems simply.
 Strong analytical skills. You're comfortable getting into the data yourself, and you know how to turn what you find into a clear recommendation.
 A track record of leading through influence , ideally on a horizontal or platform team, aligning product teams and business stakeholders around shared goals.
 A strong ability to translate across technical and non-technical domains. You're comfortable going deep on trade-offs with engineers and bringing business stakeholders along.
 A commitment to earning customer trust , building experiences that serve customers for the long term.
 Exceptional communication, strategic thinking, and execution skills , with the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and motivate teams around bold goals.
 Bonus points (but not a deal-breaker) if you have: 
 Experience building chat, messaging, or omni-channel communication products.
 Experience building AI or LLM-powered products, such as AI agents, assistants, or help desk platforms (for example, Fin or Zendesk AI).
 Experience working closely with Customer Success, Marketing, or Support organizations.
 Experience in vertical SaaS or serving small businesses.

 Location 
 We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person. We prefer candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo . We're also open to exceptional candidates working remotely in Canada.
 Compensation 
 At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $120,120, a midpoint of $171,600, and a maximum salary of $223,080, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.
 We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills and experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop.
 Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. You'll also have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.
 We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!
 What you can expect from Jobber: 
 A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.
 A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.
 A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.
 To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.
 We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process. 
 A bit more about us: 
 Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!
